name: Egypt, Jordan, and Israel Holy Land Tour
description: Be ready for Holy Land Tours from Ibis Egypt Tours, make a combine tour between holy land countries and visit the holy land destination, churches and places. Visit Coptic churches in Egypt and immortal Giza Pyramids, then move to Jordan and visit the amazing Petra Rock and Amman, after that depart to Israel with very incredible sightseeing to Jaffa, Galilee Sea, Valley of Armageddon, Nazareth and Tiberias, as well as visit New and Old Jerusalem with Mount of Olives.
overview: Be ready for Holy Land Tours from Ibis Egypt Tours, make a combine tour between holy land countries and visit the holy land destination, churches and places. Visit Coptic churches in Egypt and immortal Giza Pyramids, then move to Jordan and visit the amazing Petra Rock and Amman, after that depart to Israel with very incredible sightseeing to Jaffa, Galilee Sea, Valley of Armageddon, Nazareth and Tiberias, as well as visit New and Old Jerusalem with Mount of Olives.

itinerary.title: Arrive Cairo
itinerary.description: Once your flight landing at Cairo airport, Ibis Egypt tours representative will be waiting for you, holding a sign with your name, then he will transfer you to your hotel in Cairo. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Pyramids – Museum – Coptic Cairo Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy tasty breakfast at your hotel, then Ibis Egypt tours tour guide will escort you to Pyramids of Giza and The Egyptian Museum, start your tour by visiting the three Pyramids of Cheops, Chephren and Mykerinus, then move to Panorama area, enjoy fabulous photos for the three Pyramids, next move to the Sphinx, visit the Valley Temple, Enjoy Lunch at local restaurant in Cairo , continue your Cairo Day Tour by visiting the Egyptian Museum, it is one of the most famous museums in the world, next round will be to Old Cairo including visits to the various Churches there ( Visit maximum 02 churches ), visit Ben Ezra Synagogue, at the end of your day tours back to your hotel. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Cairo St, Catherine Tour
itinerary.description: Ibis Egypt tours tour guide will pick you up from your hotel in Cairo, he will escort you by air-conditioned vehicle to unforgettable trip to St. Catherine, passing by Moses Eyes, continue driving till arrive to the seven daughters Monastery, have a short visit to the seven Daughters Monastery, continue driving till arrive to St. Catherine, check in, manage to relax at hotel, enjoy the relish of your dinner at hotel. Overnight in St. Catherine

itinerary.title: Moses Mountains, St. Catherine Monastery
itinerary.description: Wake up call at 01:30 am., A cup of tea will be offered to each person for free, around 02:00 am, it is your chance to escape the crowds, try different adventure while climbing Moses mountain, enjoy the sun rising over Sinai Mountains, then come down for a magical visit to St. Catherine Monastery, passing by Room of the Skulls, the last point will be to the famous burning bush, at the end of your tour transfer to Taba border, cross the Israel border to Eilat and shot tour in Eilat, and transfer to Jordan border where you will find our tour guide waiting you, transfer to Petra, and have dinner. Overnight in Petra

itinerary.title: Petra Tour – Amman
itinerary.description: Enjoy your tasty breakfast at your hotel, we will begin to explore the Red Rose City Petra. First established sometime around the 06th century BC by Nabataean Arabs, a nomadic tribe who settled in the area and laid the foundations of a commercial empire that extended into Syria. Despite successive attempts by the Seleucid king Antigonus, the Roman emperor Pompey and Herod the Great to bring Petra under the control of their respective empires, Petra remained largely in Nabataean hands until around 100AD, when the Romans took over. It was still inhabited during the Byzantine period, when the former Roman Empire moved its focus east to Constantinople, but declined in importance thereafter. The Crusaders constructed a fort there in the 12th century, but soon withdrew, leaving Petra to the local people until the early 19th century, when it was visited by the Swiss explorer Johann Ludwig Burckhardt. Upon arrival you will begin an unforgettable trip on horseback to the Siq and then by foot until you reach the Treasury. The local guide will give a brief history of the city. You will also see Pharaoh's Castle, the Triumphal Arch, the Amphitheater and Monastery. Late afternoon, we departure to Amman and assist with checking you into your hotel in Amman. Overnight in Amman

itinerary.title: Amman Tour
itinerary.description: Morning time, we leave Petra toward Amman. Your first visit is to Madaba, where the St George's Greek Orthodox Church has a famous mosaic on the floor. Made during the 6th century AD, the mosaic shows the pilgrimage from the surrounding areas to the Holy Land. Your next visit recalls the story of Moses and his journey to the Promised Land. At Mount Nebo there is a Memorial for Musa (Moses) and a 4th century church which Italian Franciscan priests excavated and restored in 1933. The panoramic view overlooks the Jordan River Valley, the Dead Sea, Jericho and Jerusalem. In the Bible story, Moses does not ever arrive at the Promised Land, but he is able to see it from a distance before he dies. It is from Mount Nebo that one can see it in the distance (on a clear day). It is also believed that this is the burial place of Moses. Our last stop will be in the Dead Sea, the lowest point on earth, 417 m (1,373 ft.) below sea level and the largest "Natural Spa" in the world. The mineral-rich waters and mud flow with natural health and beauty benefits acclaimed globally. At the end of you tour transfer back to your hotel. Overnight in Amman

itinerary.title: Amman – Jaffa – Tel Aviv
itinerary.description: At 7:00 Am drive crossing to Israel via the Allenby Bridge. We continue to drive by Jericho and to the Mediterranean Sea to visit the 4,000 years old Port City of Jaffa, and explore the old town of Jaffa and its restored structures, this is the port allowed cedars from Lebanon to arrive for the construction of King Solomon’s Temple. Finally we arrive in Tel Aviv - Israel’s largest and most modern city. Check in at our hotel and dinner. Free time to rest, relax and enjoy your first evening in Israel. Overnight in Tel Aviv Meals: Breakfast and Dinner (Full Buffet)

itinerary.title: Jaffa – Galilee - Valley of Armageddon - Caesarea - Mt. Carmel - Megiddo – Nazareth - Tiberias
itinerary.description: In the morning visit to the Old Town Jaffa, walk through the narrow passages of Old Jaffa, believed to be the oldest port city in the world and where cedars arrived to build Solomon's Temple. Leave Tel Aviv driving to north along the coastal plain to Caesarea Maritima, which was the center of early Christians, and capital of Judea under the Romans. Visit the excavations of this ancient city, the Roman theatre and aqueduct, we'll stop at Mount Carmel (Muckrake), we continue and enjoy a breath taking panoramic view of Haifa Bay and the Western Galilee region. Continue to Megiddo, identified as the site of Armageddon, see the remains from Solomon’s days, and view the site where the Battle of Armageddon will be fought. Visit the archaeological excavations at Megiddo, including the well preserved water supply system. Continue along the Jezerel Valley to visit the town of, we will take a beautiful view from the top of Mt. Precipice, also known as Mount of Precipitation, or Mount of the Leap of the Lord. It's believed to be the site of the rejection of Jesus (Luke 4:29 Luke 4:30), continue to the Church of Annunciation if time permits, and we'll drive to Cana of Galilee where Jesus performed his first public miracle, the turning of water into wine at the wedding feast, and the Lower Galilee region to the beautiful Sea of Galilee to the town of Tiberias. Overnight Sea of Galilee Meals: Breakfast and Dinner (Full Buffet)

itinerary.title: Sea of Galilee, the Upper Galilee and the Golan Heights
itinerary.description: Breakfast at your hotel and get ready for sailing in the Sea of Galilee as Jesus did with his disciples, this is exactly how we begin the day by boarding a wooden boat and sailing on as the disciples did 2000 years ago. We’ll dock at Kibbutz Nof Ginosar and visit the ancient “Jesus Boat,” the remains of a 2,000 years old boat that was discovered in 1986 in the shores of the lake. We will drive to the beautiful Golan Heights. Visit Banias- ancient Ceasarea Philippi, where Jesus said “On this rock I will build my Church.” Continue to the Hula Valley and the Upper Galilee, returning to the Sea of Galilee with visit to Yardenit- the baptismal site on the Jordan River, the river where John the Baptist, baptized Jesus. Overnight Sea of Galilee Meals: Breakfast and Dinner (Full Buffet)

itinerary.title: Mount of Beatitudes / Tabgha / Capernaum / Beit She'an / Dead Sea
itinerary.description: Breakfast and today we visit the surrounding area of the Sea of Galilee where Jesus began his early Ministry. Start with the Mount of Beatitudes, here Jesus preached the Sermon on the Mount, see the beautiful Chapel, and enjoy the panoramic view of the Galilee. Continue down to Tabgha- the site of the Feeding of the 5,000 and Primacy of Peter, at the Church of Multiplication with its 4th Century Mosaic floor, and a must visit during your Holy Land tour to Capernaum –referred as Jesus “own town” where is believed to have been Jesus' home and the center of his ministry, here we can stand in what is left of the synagogue in which Jesus ministered, and where he preformed many miracles, and it's in Capernaum where Peter’s mother-in-law lived and was healed. We’ll continue through the Valley of Beit She'an to the ancient city of Beit She'an, view the impressive archeological site. It was here that after defeating Saul and his sons on Mount Gilboa, the Philistines hanged their bodies on the walls of Beth Shean, continue through the Jordan Valley past the city of Jericho and arrive to the Dead Sea, the lowest place on earth. Check in at the hotel located at the shores of the Dead Sea, enjoy optional spa treatments and a massage, swim and float on the salty water of the Dead Sea or enjoy a swim in your hotel pool. Overnight in Dead Sea Meals: Breakfast and Dinner (Full Buffet)

itinerary.title: Dead Sea, Masada, Ein Gedi, Qumran, Judean Desert, Jerusalem
itinerary.description: Breakfast and enjoy your holy land tour to Masada, 1500 feet mountaintop fortress of Masada famous for being the last stronghold of the Jewish rebellion against the Roman Empire. We’ll ascend to Masada by cable car and explore the first century Synagogue, King Herod’s Bathhouse and other sites atop of Masada, descend and continue to the oasis of Ein Gedi, where David hid in a cave when running from Saul, it was here that David composed several of his Psalms, continue a visit to Qumran where a cache of ancient biblical texts the Dead Sea Scroll were discovered in 1947. From here on to the Golden City of Jerusalem, and proceed to a panoramic view of Jerusalem from Mt. Scopus, where we can take time for prayer. Continue to the hotel conveniently located within walking distance from the Old City Jerusalem. Overnight in Jerusalem Meals: Breakfast and Dinner (Full Buffet)

itinerary.title: Old Jerusalem - Mount of Olives - Garden of Gethsemane - Western Wall tunnels - Church of Holy Sepulcher
itinerary.description: Breakfast and begin our tour to top of Mount of Olives where the Lord ascended into heaven, and where we will have a view across the Kidron Valley to the Eastern Gate where the prince of Peace will enter. Continuing to Pater Noster Church and visit Dominus Flevit where "The Lord wept" as he beheld the Holy City. Through Palm Sunday Road proceed down to the Gethsemane where you will see 2,000 year old Olive trees that date back to the time of Jesus. Then to the Western Wall- The holiest site in Judaism and one of the original walls that retained the Temple. We will visit the Western Wall Tunnels running along the base of the Western Wall will leading us through the Second Temple era and reveal the incredible construction of the Temple Mount, water supply and Roman street where our Lord Jesus was led to judgment. Continue to St. Anne Church and the Pool of Bethesda. We will walk the Stations of the Cross- the Via Dolorosa to visit Judgment Hall of Pilate all the way to Church of the Holy Sepulcher. In the afternoon you will enjoy time to shop the colorful bazaars (markets). We'll return and join the prayer at the Western Wall- Pray and leave a note in the crevices of the wall as many Christian pilgrims before you, return to the Hotel for Shabbat Dinner. Overnight in Jerusalem Meals: Breakfast and Dinner (Full Buffet)

itinerary.title: Jerusalem Old and New City
itinerary.description: We start our day with tasty breakfast and drive to Mt. Zion with a visit to the Upper room, where Jesus held the Lord’s Supper, visit King David Tomb, and walk through the Jewish Quarter. Continue on a drive through the New City of Jerusalem and pass the Israel Parliament (Knesset), and continue to Ein Kareem, birthplace of John the Baptist, visit the Church of the Visitation at Ein Kareem then we proceed to Bethlehem to visit the Church of the Nativity. Visit the Shepherd’s Field, where an angel appeared to announce the birth of Jesus. In the afternoon visit the Garden Tomb, to celebrate the resurrection with a time for prayer. Enjoy an evening farewell Dinner at the hotel. Overnight Jerusalem Meals: Dinner

itinerary.title: Free day in Jerusalem
itinerary.description: After Breakfast, and by 12 noon, you can walk distance to the Old City or visit again the Holy sites and the colorful bazaars. Overnight Jerusalem Meals: Dinner

itinerary.title: Tel Aviv - Final Departure
itinerary.description: Today we will say goodbye, once you enjoy your tasty breakfast, Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to Ben Gurion Airport International airport for final departure
